questions.question: 1) Which mathematical relationship is used to determine lattice parameters from diffraction data?
2) In a powder X-ray diffraction experiment, why is a powdered sample used instead of a single crystal?

answers.b: To ensure random orientation of crystallites for all possible diffraction angles
answers.c: To increase the penetration depth of X-rays

questions.question: 3) In Bragg's law, : nλ = 2d sin⁡θ,  what does ‘λ’ represent ?

answers.a: The lattice constant of the unit cell
answers.b: Distance between atoms in the unit cell
answers.d: The wavelength of the incident X-ray

questions.question: 4) The most accurate method for determining lattice parameters involves:

answers.a: Measuring the full-width at half maximum (FWHM) of peaks
answers.b: Using high-angle diffraction peaks and extrapolation techniques

questions.question: 5) What does the '2θ' value in an XRD plot represent?

answers.b: The angle between the incident and diffracted X-rays
answers.c: The atomic number of the elements in the sample
answers.d: The temperature at which the sample is analysed
